cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

mechanism: A controls closing time and offers an account in exchange for B confirming an independently moving shadow before admitting a personal act of belief.
confusable: Unlike asking someone to believe a claim, A waits for B noticing admission before revealing having held the door.
comparison: Closing a room after a shadow leaves differs from replacing cold soup before revealing hospitality to a noodle.
seedUse: D160-a shadow, chair and held door; S02-a delays closing and solicits company through a negotiated account.
